newsitem.title: FRANCE: Gunman still holds hostage in Paris siege - police.
newsitem.headline: Gunman still holds hostage in Paris siege - police.

text.p: An armed man who took 35 people hostage in central Paris was still holding one person captive, a police official said, contradicting an earlier report.

Two people were slightly injured and taken to hospital in the hostage-taking by a 55-year-old man with a grievance against a former employer, the official said. Earlier, a police official said all 35 hostages had been released.
